nodes.description: Public uint256 total token supply declared in EIP20Interface, written in the AporooToken constructor.
Mapping address=>uint256 of token balances, written in constructor/transfer/transferFrom and read in balanceOf.
Nested mapping address=>address=>uint256 of spending allowances, written in approve/transferFrom and read in allowance.
Public string token name set once in the constructor.
Public uint8 number of display decimals set once in the constructor.
Public string token symbol set once in the constructor.
Constant private uint256 equal to 2**256-1, used as the infinite-allowance sentinel in transferFrom.
Constructor: assigns the whole initial supply to msg.sender and sets totalSupply, name, decimals and symbol.
Public transfer: checks sender balance, decrements sender and increments recipient, emits Transfer.
Public transferFrom: reads allowance, checks balance/allowance, moves tokens and decrements allowance unless it is MAX_UINT256.
View function returning balances[_owner].
Public approve: sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value and emits Approval.
View function returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
Caller-controlled address used as balance owner, spender index and allowance owner across the contract.
balances[msg.sender] -= _value inside transfer; unchecked uint256 subtraction (guarded only by require).
balances[_to] += _value inside transfer; unchecked uint256 addition.
balances[_to] += _value inside transferFrom; unchecked uint256 addition.
balances[_from] -= _value inside transferFrom; unchecked uint256 subtraction.
allowed[_from][msg.sender] -= _value inside transferFrom, only executed when allowance < MAX_UINT256; unchecked uint256 subtraction.
Constructor parameter carrying the initial token supply.
Constructor parameter used to set the token name.
Constructor parameter used to set the decimals value.
Constructor parameter used to set the token symbol.
Recipient address parameter of transfer and transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transfer, transferFrom and approve.
Source address parameter of transferFrom, also the balance owner debited.
Address parameter of balanceOf and allowance used as the lookup key.
Spender address parameter of approve and allowance.
Local uint256 allowance in transferFrom caching allowed[_from][msg.sender].

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the key whose balance is decremented by _value.
msg.sender indexes the nested allowance mapping that is decremented, so the allowance owner is caller-controlled.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender], using the caller as the allowance owner.
_value is the operand subtracted from balances[msg.sender] in transfer.
_value is the operand added to balances[_to] in transfer.
_value is the operand added to balances[_to] in transferFrom.
_value is the operand subtracted from balances[_from] in transferFrom.
_value is the operand subtracted from the stored allowance.
_from selects the balance that is decremented in transferFrom.
_to selects the balance that is incremented in transfer.
_to selects the balance that is incremented in transferFrom.
Cached local allowance gates and mirrors the allowance subtraction.
_initialAmount is written into balances[msg.sender] by the constructor.
transfer executes the sender balance subtraction after the require check.
transfer executes the recipient balance addition.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom reads the allowed mapping indexed by _from and msg.sender.
transferFrom executes the recipient balance addition.
transferFrom executes the source balance subtraction.
transferFrom conditionally executes the allowance subtraction.
Constructor writes the initial balance of the creator into balances.
Constructor sets totalSupply to _initialAmount.
approve writes the allowed allowance mapping for the caller.
balanceOf reads balances[_owner].
allowance reads allowed[_owner][_spender].
_owner is the lookup key used by balanceOf.
_owner is the outer key used by allowance.
_spender is the key approved inside approve.
_spender is the inner key used by allowance.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter only feeds the constructor state writes.
Constructor parameter only sets the name state variable.
Constructor parameter only sets the decimals state variable.
Constructor parameter only sets the symbol state variable.
Recipient parameter is used solely to select the credited balance in transfer/transferFrom.
Amount parameter drives the unchecked arithmetic in transfer.
Source parameter selects the debited balance and allowance lookup in transferFrom.
Lookup key parameter of the read-only balanceOf/allowance getters.
Spender parameter is the key written by approve and read by allowance.
